name: Silverstone Circuit
coordinates: x east, z south, y up; meters
bank_convention: Positive bank raises the geometric left road edge relative to center

metadata.layout: Motorcycle Grand Prix Arena circuit (Wing pits), 18 turns (10 right, 8 left): Abbey, Farm, Village, The Loop, Aintree, Wellington Straight, Brooklands, Luffield, Woodcote, Copse, Maggotts, Becketts, Chapel, Hangar Straight, Stowe, Vale, Club

start_finish.source: APPROXIMATE: OSM node 13036050130 tagged raceway=start/finish on Hamilton Straight (Wing pits); the 10 m Sentinel-2 imagery cannot resolve the painted grid, and whether the MotoGP start line coincides with this node (OSM also has a separate raceway=finish node 13036050131, about 150 m earlier) is unverified

width.status: Published width; no open imagery fine enough to measure edges
